text:
GENERATE BURST GD11W-0_0 — Run C-9 P5, FOREST layer panel 0_0 over a conductor LAYOUT GUIDE (Matt R-C9-29). task_id "GD11W-0_0".

IMAGE 1 is the canvas to EDIT (1536x1024): the flat colours are a LAYOUT GUIDE: DARK GREEN = dense manuscript forest seen from high above and far away (tiny tree crowns, a few px to about 20 px across, deep greens and dark olive in shadow); LIGHT BLUE line = the ONE river, catching the sunset (exactly where the line runs); ORANGE area ringed by BLACK = a LARGE SWATHE OF BURNING FOREST: a wide front of orange flames among blackened standing trunks, charred black ground at its edge, thick dark smoke rolling up and drifting right — fill the WHOLE orange area with fire and the black ring with burnt, smouldering forest; PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty sky above the treeline (keep it flat pure #00ff00, clean treetop edge).
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and replace every flat guide colour with painting. Follow the guide EXACTLY: no river or fire anywhere the guide does not put one; no two burning swathes alike. LIGHT AND MOOD (Matt): DARK sunset mood — the sun is low at screen-LEFT: warm gold and orange rim light on slopes that face left, deep violet-indigo shadow everywhere else, a purple-violet smoky haze that thickens with distance and veils the farther ground; fires glow orange and throw dark smoke drifting to the right. Rich, deep mineral colour (indigo, violet, rose, ochre-gold, deep green), never pastel. STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above; IMAGE 2 sets the mood, darkness and painted hand to match (NOT its layout). No towns, no villages, no houses, no characters, text, UI or border.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if a painted strip was altered, a join remains, anything appears that the guide does not put there (an extra landmark, fire, river or any town), the sky area is not flat pure #00ff00, or guide colours remain unpainted — name the reason. Copy the output to out/GD11W-0_0.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "GD11W-0_0"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the canvas to EDIT (painted neighbour strips + layout guide)
IMAGE 2 — the approved DARK SUNSET MOOD and painted hand (Matt); NOT its layout
IMAGE 3 — tree scale and forest painting ONLY (not its layout or its lighter mood)
